svg.title: How Blueprint runs
svg.desc: A tree from top to bottom: you, helm, the top dock, and child docks and agents on workbenches. Each lead assembles context, a selector picks the next phase, requests go down and hand-backs come up.
svg.text: Every lead has the same structure: assemble context, then the selector picks the next phase. Requests and workbenches go down; hand-backs in one format come up.
Finds what you want; one page for helm
One per job · owns the stages
System prompt · identical at every step
What's wanted? The bar? What's good?
No files or methods yet; you answer intent
problem statement · asks you in build
Split into stages? What's this one for?
Main contradiction first: the key unknown
stage table · you review in build
Does it really give you what you want?
Big picture; human calls go to you
enough → finish; not → back to plan
Stage goes to the top dock; hands off
Still replies; changes go by note to dock
no output; woken when top dock returns
once chosen, insert that phase's page
all the context written for the child at dispatch
context, not control: how is its call
+ workbench: the top dock's is the whole product
Workbenches and integration · one per stage
System prompt · identical at every step
What is this part really solving?
What makes this kind work? Then this one
problem statement; each part gets its bar
Which parts? Give to dock or run?
Quality in the fit? One whole, one run
Does it really meet this part's aim?
Connected and running is enough; helm judges
Which benches now? Which parts fit?
Dispatch what's ready; log the rest
bench + request; woken when batch returns
Wire each return in; fix seams yourself
once chosen, insert that phase's page
Several wholes → child dock, split again · One whole → any one agent, end to end; its inner steps aren't expanded
A bench is the checking station the parent builds: the child's workspace holds only this slot, output goes in 交付/
woken when all return · branch merges up
Talk to any agent anytime · stop only stops that one
from node doc at loop ends
